view: View from shadowed Maya corbel-vault passage across Palenque palace courtyard with characteristic four-level square observation tower beyond, weathered limestone and jungle edge, no round Roman arches or invented city.

eras.title: Rooms open to the forest
eras.caption: Palenque's palace and temples preserve fine stonework, stucco and carved accounts of its rulers. Roofless rooms and surviving vaulted passages reveal how builders arranged courts and interiors within the forested hills.
